newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: Malaysia slams West for snubbing solar summit.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia slams West for snubbing solar summit.

text.p: Malaysian Prime Minister Mahathir Mohamad has criticised rich Western countries for showing little interest in a World Solar Summit opening in Harare on Monday.

Mahathir, vice chairman of a commission of world leaders set up to prepare for the conference, told reporters on Sunday evening that developed countries should help poorer nations with solar technologies.
"It seems from the response to this summit that people with the funds and technology to help are not too keen to participate in this summit," he said.
"The unfortunate thing is that we need solar technology because the initial costs of projects that need to be done are just too high for some countries."

Mahathir is one of 10 heads of state and government -- all from developing countries -- who have turned up for the two-day summit called to drum up political support for the development and use of solar and other renewable energy sources.
